format.description: Output format the pages were rendered to.

pages.description: Every page rendered, sorted by source path.

RenderedPage.description: A page written by the render phase.

data.description: The `data` of the page's [`RenderResult`]. Omitted when null.

metadata.description: The document's metadata after the transform phase.

path.description:
Where the page was written, relative to the output directory, with
`/` separators, e.g. `guide/intro.html`.
